svg.title: Accessibility score definition — linear score and 2SFCA score compared
svg.desc: Two panels. Top panel shows the linear accessibility score: a straight line from 100 at 0 minutes to 0 at 60 minutes, with category bands marked. Bottom panel contrasts what the linear score and 2SFCA score each capture.
svg.text: Applied consistently to all origins; NaN travel times return 0
